definitions.explanation: A three-dimensional representation of a person, animal, or figure, created by carving, casting, or sculpting. Includes both traditional and modern sculptural works.

examples.japanese: {公園|こうえん}に{彫像|ちょうぞう}が{立|た}っている。
examples.english: A statue stands in the park.

examples.japanese: {大理石|だいりせき}の{彫像|ちょうぞう}が{美術館|びじゅつかん}に{展示|てんじ}されている。
examples.english: A marble statue is exhibited at the art museum.

examples.japanese: この{寺|てら}には{平安|へいあん}{時代|じだい}に{作|つく}られた{仏|ほとけ}の{彫像|ちょうぞう}が{数多|かずおお}く{残|のこ}されている。
examples.english: This temple preserves numerous Buddhist statues made during the Heian period.

notes:
Composed of {彫|ちょう} (carve/engrave) + {像|ぞう} (image/figure). Refers specifically to three-dimensional sculptural works, as opposed to flat reliefs or paintings.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {彫像|ちょうぞう}を{作|つく}る: to make a statue
- {青銅|せいどう}の{彫像|ちょうぞう}: bronze statue
- {大理石|だいりせき}の{彫像|ちょうぞう}: marble statue
- {仏|ぶつ}の{彫像|ちょうぞう}: Buddhist statue/sculpture

SIMILAR WORDS:
- {像|ぞう}: statue/image — broader term, includes any representational figure
- {銅像|どうぞう}: bronze statue — specifically made of bronze
- {塑像|そぞう}: clay figure — made by molding rather than carving
- {彫刻|ちょうこく}: sculpture — the art form or practice, broader than {彫像|ちょうぞう}
